family.description: Members of this family act as galactosyltransferases, belonging to glycosyltransferase family 92 [[cite:PUB00075505],[cite:PUB00075506],[cite:PUB00075507]]. The aligned region contains several conserved cysteine residues and several charged residues that may be catalytic residues. This is supported by the inclusion of this family in the GT-A glycosyl transferase superfamily.
family.name: Glycosyltransferase family 92
